Team Hub — structure wireframe

Review question: how should Team Hub separate workspace membership from per-company access, and how should role state be displayed without the misleading on/off toggle found in the 2026-09-14 audit?

Wireframe v1 · BIGDROPS ERP · low fidelity · grayscale on purpose · 2026-09-14

Reference: what the current Team Hub shows today (the problem being tested)

Today each member row shows one pill per role template with an on/off state and Grant / Remove buttons. The state is computed as coverage of entity_permissions rows on the active company — it is not a stored assignment. Overlapping grants and template edits after assignment make the display wrong in both directions. Source: docs/tickets/settings-information-architecture-ux-redesign.md §6.

Engineer — Remove Manager — Grant Viewer — Grant Company Admin — Grant

Problem: this reads as a stored switch. The data model has no such switch — only expanded permission rows. The three directions below each replace it.

Section 2 · Company — access in one company at a time

Tradeoff: clearest scope separation — workspace people and company access never mix on one row. Cost: a member’s access is one section away from their name, and the reviewer must pick a company to see anything.

Tradeoff: leanest list and the most mobile-friendly; every quick “who is in this workspace?” glance costs one tap less. Cost: reviewing access requires opening each member, and the desktop two-pane layout needs its own confirmation with real content density.

Open questions for reviewers

  • Should granting and revoking abilities stay in Team Hub at all, or move to a company-scoped “Access” section (audit ticket §4 puts Team under Workspace and roles under the company)?
  • Is a derived summary chip like “≈ Engineer” helpful, or should the display show only the ability list (Direction B shows no chips)?
  • Does the owner need a view of one member’s access across all companies in one screen? No direction shows that today.
  • Where does invite expiry editing belong — invite creation only, or also on the pending row?
  • Remove / Transfer ownership / Revoke are shown as plain stubs. Confirm placement before any visual design pass.
